Class NkFont

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<NkFont>
org.lwjgl.nuklear.NkFont
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
@NativeType("struct nk_font") public class NkFont extends Struct<NkFont> implements NativeResource
struct nk_font {
    struct nk_font * next;
    struct nk_user_font handle;
    struct nk_baked_font info;
    float scale;
    struct nk_font_glyph * glyphs;
    struct nk_font_glyph const * fallback;
    nk_rune fallback_codepoint;
    nk_handle texture;
    struct nk_font_config * config;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • NkFont

      public NkFont(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a NkFont instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
